entries.designBrief: A distinctive mountain-forged fantasy spear with a broad steel leaf point clasped between two unequal wing-shaped dark-iron retainers, one short backward barb and a carved bone collar. Solid faceted steel, finely etched mountain knots, dark ashwood shaft and braided leather grip, compact ivory ferrule at the butt. A small translucent pale quartz piece is embedded in the neck with only a subtle cool glint. Neutral reflected light shows all metal planes. No glowing edge, no lightning, no crystalline neon blade. Attractive uncommon level15 craftsmanship; visibly simpler than elite arms.

entries.designBrief: A prestigious royal greatsword with a SOLID broad burnished silver-steel blade: long largely parallel planes, a short angular shoulder and a clean elongated diamond point. No skeletal open rails, no long glowing fuller, no crystal blade. Shallow etched laurel and small heraldic relief near the ricasso show masterwork craftsmanship. New hilt design: an elegant asymmetrical S-shaped silver crossguard formed as folded laurel branches, one quillon turns upward and the other downward, subtle pale-gold clasps and a small embossed royal shield rather than the previous huge winged lion guard. Long deep navy leather grip with visible wrapping, capped by a pierced but solid crown pommel. ONE small rich sapphire cabochon inset in the ricasso/guard junction has a softly lit blue interior. A few very short tiny blue rune inlays close to this stone, rest of blade is visibly METAL illuminated by reflected neutral studio-like painterly light. Noble refined and powerful because of proportions, silver craftsmanship and material quality, not energy. Its SOLID straight blade and S-guard must be clearly different from any triangular crystal Highland Claymore.

entries.license: Original project artwork generated with OpenAI image generation; applicable OpenAI output terms. No stock/APK art or exclusivity claim.

entries.designBrief: A newly designed prestigious desert fantasy saber: a deep, graceful forward-curved blade of lustrous dark crucible STEEL with a distinct broadened yelman near the point, an angular false-edge step and delicate NON-glowing etched sun-map patterns across broad metal planes. Blade is solid and substantial, not a glowing gold channel or luminous rail. Strong contrasting materials: a segmented polished IVORY grip, sculpted aged BRONZE falcon-beak pommel, and a finely pierced COPPER half-basket knuckle guard shaped as overlapping architectural sun rays, with tiny engraved fasteners rather than the previous giant exposed solar wheel. The blade's silver cutting bevel and dark steel body catch generous neutral reflected light; copper and ivory remain visibly different. Magical treatment differs from the sword: just THREE small recessed amber-gold enchanted inscriptions near the blade shoulder/hilt, a restrained soft warm illumination confined to these glyphs and nearby copper. No glowing edge, no flame, no blanket gold color. The appeal comes primarily from sculptural desert craftsmanship, elegant curve, ivory/bronze contrast and confident material rendering. Sophisticated elite level60 artifact, not ordinary historical saber and not arcade neon.

Ancient imperial relief and dark-silver buttresses around two narrow protected windows, not a floating crystal head. entries.name: Eclipse Gatehammer
entries.license: Original project artwork generated with OpenAI image generation; applicable OpenAI output terms. No stock/APK art or exclusivity claim.

entries.designBrief: A monumental and beautiful imperial gate-breaking fantasy HAMMER with clear physical MASS. A huge oblique rectangular striking head of polished obsidian has a broad opaque dark faceted impact face, held by substantial carved DARK-SILVER buttresses and stepped imperial braces. One long crescent horn grows above the striking block and the rear forms a lower, narrower swept crescent pick: asymmetrical structural outline, not a circular energy-axe or black hole surrounded by floating fragments. Richly engraved moon-phase silver inlays, precise layered joinery and ancient imperial relief provide endgame prestige. A thick tapering octagonal black-steel shaft has sculpted silver collars, a long textured leather grip and a heavy architectural counterweight; no repetitive glowing shaft gems. The ONLY pronounced supernatural feature is a SMALL violet void core recessed deep inside a protected aperture at the head/haft junction, occupying less than one-tenth of the head. Its violet light is concentrated INSIDE the window and lightly touches adjacent silver. No purple lightning, purple edge outlines, floating rocks, particles or broad aura. Most obsidian and silver must be clearly visible in strong neutral reflected highlights and midtones, even if the violet core were mentally removed. Endgame awe from craftsmanship, material weight, severe elegant silhouette and unusual engineered structure, not stronger bloom.
entries.magicTreatment: protected violet core with slight local glow
